semiconductor_relevance: High — JSR Micro NV specializes in advanced packaging and assembly materials critical to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: JSR Micro NV, a subsidiary of JSR Corporation, focuses on developing advanced materials for semiconductor packaging and assembly. Their product portfolio includes adhesives, epoxies, die attach compounds, and underfill materials, catering to the needs of shrinking and complex semiconductor devices.
capabilities: Adhesives and epoxies for semiconductor applications
